validation_split_policy.basis: Frozen before viewing any full COD ranking. Entire Dara ternary mixtures (both scan durations), CPD4 and NIST_676a are held out; other cases are development inputs. No PFSM parameter may be tuned using holdout rankings.
validation_split_policy.grouping: Dara 2min/8min scans of the same mixture stay in one physical sample family. Input readiness checks do not constitute PFSM identification.
validation_split_policy.release: Run development cases first, freeze algorithm/options, then evaluate holdout once. A failed holdout remains a failure of that frozen version; it cannot silently become tuning data.
